messages:
maya liu: FYI dropped new Members drawer prototype in Figma — reduces invite flow to 2 taps and moves role pick inline. Link: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/members-drawer
carol nguyen: Nice. Quick q: where does SSO enforcement live? I don't want admins to miss that it's team-level vs org-level
maya liu: Good catch — current comp shows an 'SSO' chip under member identity. Hover reveals scope, but we debated explicit label 'SSO enforced (org)' vs icon. Thoughts?
ryan cortez: Lean toward 'SSO: Org enforced' text — icons get ignored. But make it visually lighter. Also, audit nav: currently buried under 'More' menu. We should bring 'Audit logs' to top-level for enterprise admins.
jules park: Agree on audit. Also accessibility nit: role dropdown in compact mode has low contrast focus ring — needs 3:1 at minimum. Samir, can you add to a11y tickets?
samir desai: Yup logging ticket now. Also concern: inline role assignment could lead to accidental grants. Suggest confirmation microcopy: 'Assign role X to user Y — confirm'.
maya liu: Maybe show role summary pill + small chevron to expand detailed perms. Default collapsed.
carol nguyen: Also think about seat allocation UX for reserved capacity customers — maybe show 'Seat type' next to role: 'Seat: Dedicated' so billing team knows.
ryan cortez: Copy tweak: change 'Invite' CTA to 'Add member' for clarity when seats are zero allowed. And change success toast to 'Member added — invitation email queued' :thumbsup:
jules park: Quick snippet for new toast copy: `Member added · Invitation email sent (or user will be added when SSO approves)`
design-bot: Snapshot posted: members-drawer-v2-2026-03-23.png
maya liu: One more: keyboard flow — tab order goes: name -> email -> roles -> invite CTA. We need to ensure audit link is reachable after invite without extra tabbing. Maybe add keyboard shortcut `g a` for Audit logs.
samir desai: Accessibility: make role chips actionable buttons with aria-expanded states. Also add `aria-describedby` for SSO labels that open details.
carol nguyen: UX question: for inherited roles, how do we surface 'source' (group vs direct)? Suggest small 'from group' hint under the pill.
maya liu: We'll iterate on showing source inline on hover and in collapsed list. I'll update figma and push new frames.
ryan cortez: LGTM. Schedule a quick review tomorrow 10am? I'll bring PM and infra.
jules park: Can PM @eva verify what happens with invite links when SSO provisioning is enabled?
eva singh: @jules yes, invite links are disabled when SSO provisioning is enforced. I'll add line to the doc.
maya liu: Thanks all — I'll post updated frames and the accessibility checklist.
